//: SAFE EXAMPLE ONLY — do not put real secrets here. Copy the servers you want into `.cursor/mcp.json` (gitignored) or configure them in the Cursor dashboard for Cloud Agents. See docs/cursor-mcp-cloud-setup.md. Env values shown as ${VARS} must be provided via your environment / Cursor secrets, never committed.

github.//: GitHub MCP (remote). Recommended for issue/PR/code context. Use a fine-grained PAT with least privilege (read-only where possible). Configure the token as a secret in the Cursor dashboard for Cloud Agents — do not inline it.

supabase.//: Supabase MCP — DEV/READ-ONLY ONLY. Point at a dev/branch project, never production. Prefer --read-only and a --project-ref scoped to a non-prod project. Provide SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN via env/dashboard secret.

playwright.//: Playwright/browser MCP (local) — for in-browser verification, visual/responsive/a11y QA. Local-only; drives a browser on the machine running the agent. No secrets required.

figma.//: Figma MCP (optional) — only if doing design-to-code work. Requires a Figma access token; provide via env/dashboard secret. Remove if design work is not relevant.

context7.//: Context/code-docs search MCP (optional) — up-to-date library/API docs for grounding. Uses an API key if you have one; otherwise omit the header. Cloud-safe (read-only docs).

sequential-thinking.//: Structured planning/reasoning scratchpad (MCP reference server). No secrets, takes no external actions, cloud-safe. Optional aid for multi-step planning.
